name: Dara Sok
scenario_title: A Sunday Invitation to the Community
action: Dara gives the clerk a small, polite smile and nods slightly. "That is very kind. I have my porridge waiting, and I am tired from work. But I will think about it." They adjust the bag of ginger in their hand, give another brief nod, and turn to begin the familiar walk home.
reason: Dara felt the warmth of the receipt and the weight of the clerk's invitation, which stirred a brief memory of their mother humming to similar music at family feasts. Though the hall was not far, they were physically tired from the night shift and mindful of the porridge waiting at home. They reflected on their habit of staying on the edge of gatherings, never joining the singing even in Phnom Penh, and concluded that while the invitation was kind, it did not change their tiredness or their preference to keep their life close. So they politely thanked the clerk, left the door open just a little, and turned toward their familiar walk home.
